title: ShortCodeUsedPayload
description: Payload of the ShortCodeUsed event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain; INV-Q-11266). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

code.description: The registered short code that has just been used in an aggregate number.

nodeKind.description: Whether the code belongs to an entity or a business unit.

nodeRef.description: The entityRef or businessUnitRef that holds the code.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate whose number first carried the code.

documentNumber.description: The document number of that aggregate (AGG-{entity}-{type}-{businessUnit}-{periodEnd}-{seq}).
